page.metadataDescription: Assemble exact retained excerpts into private claim assessments and related-work evidence themes. Imported report origin and semantic support remain unverified.
page.heading: Build a draft from retained excerpts.
page.introduction: Select exact claim spans, record your own assessments, and organise read excerpts into related-work themes.
page.noScript: Enable JavaScript for this local editor. No passage or report is uploaded automatically.

workspace.label: Private evidence draft
workspace.privacy: This editor uses papers marked Include in your saved review. Passage, imported reports and theme edits stay in this tab’s memory. Reloading or leaving loses them; export first. Nothing is uploaded or saved to public history. Your browser and same-origin scripts can access this page.
workspace.includeFirst: Mark papers Include in the literature workspace before assembling this draft.
workspace.changed: A selected excerpt or saved paper changed, or this draft exceeds its limit. Remove that selection or clear the draft; your edits remain below.
workspace.cleared: Draft cleared from this tab. Your saved paper list remains.

import.label: Retained Keryx report JSON
import.guidance: Use a report returned by the API/MCP with its retained citation and excerpt ledger. Bibliography alone cannot describe a paper. Imported bytes are your responsibility; this editor does not authenticate their origin.
import.success: Report imported locally. Matching excerpts are available for selection; the report origin and semantic support remain unverified.
import.refused: Report not imported. Use a unique retained report with id/queryId, subClaims, citations and evidence; check the 64 KiB draft limit. Your existing draft remains.

claim.label: Claim assessment
claim.guidance: Select a claim in the passage, then add it below. Changing the passage clears its old claim spans and assessments. Text is never rewritten to fit an excerpt.
claim.selectFirst: Select the exact claim text in your passage first.
claim.reviewer: Your name for an optional assessment
claim.unavailableGuidance: An unavailable source is never reported as unsupported.

theme.label: Related-work themes
theme.heading: Related-work evidence themes
theme.guidance: Group exact excerpts before writing. A statement about a paper is exported only with a citation and the retained excerpt you select for it; quotations and your free-form notes stay separate, and notes remain marked as unverified.
theme.assemblyGuidance: Build extractive contributions grouped by the original research targets. Each quotes retained text and stays editable. Write agreements, disagreements and gaps only after reviewing the cited excerpts. Regeneration replaces sentences in the chosen theme and preserves its title, notes and all other themes. No model or reading request is started.
theme.regenerate: Regenerate this theme from selected excerpts
theme.assembled: Retained contributions appended. Existing themes and edits were preserved; review the quotations and write comparisons in the statement editor.
theme.regenerated: This theme’s sentences were regenerated from its selected excerpts. Titles, notes and other themes were preserved.
theme.assemblyRefused: Assembly refused. Select one to 24 retained excerpts for regeneration, or make room within the 16-theme and 64 KiB limits. Your edits remain.
theme.title: Theme title
theme.unreadHeading: Included papers without usable retained excerpts

reading.guidance: Missing retained evidence does not tell us whether a paper was read. Record your observation for this exact saved record; it is not a Keryx access check. Unread and unavailable papers export in separate lists and are never described or cited.
reading.prepareGuidance: Prepare a reading request in a new tab to keep these edits. Review its question and budget before submitting through the existing reader, then import the retained report here. Preparing the request spends nothing and does not mark the paper as read.
reading.prepare: Prepare reading request in a new tab

statement.heading: Statements in this theme
statement.guidance: Write one sentence at a time. Choose what it does, the papers it names and the retained excerpt it relies on. Keryx checks that each named paper has a selected excerpt; it does not check that the excerpt supports your wording.
statement.paperUnread: {title} — no retained excerpt; cannot be described
statement.excerpts: Retained excerpts this sentence relies on
statement.empty: Write the sentence to include it in the draft.
statement.bound: Will be exported with its citation and excerpt links.
statement.authorGap: Will be exported as your own stated gap. It cites no paper and stays marked as unverified.
statement.needsOnePaper: Not exported yet: a contribution names exactly one paper.
statement.needsTwoPapers: Not exported yet: agreement and disagreement name at least two papers.
statement.needsExcerpt: Not exported yet: select a retained excerpt for every paper this sentence names.

download.success: Downloaded your current private draft. Keep the Markdown/LaTeX and reference files together.
download.refused: Export refused: an exact record or selected excerpt is unavailable or changed.
download.backupSuccess: Downloaded private draft inputs and your assessments. Keep this file private.
download.backupRefused: Backup refused: check the current exact record and excerpt selections.
